summary.business_type: Software / SaaS / Consumer Utility Tool (Cross-Platform Mobile & Desktop)
top_findings: Missing canonical link tags across 100% of pages (26/26 routes lack <link rel="canonical">)
Sitewide FAQPage schema pollution: RootLayout injects 10 FAQ Q&As onto all 26 pages, violating Google Search guidelines
Duplicated brand suffix in page titles: /guides, /support, and /terms render with '... | Printora | Printora'
Sitewide OpenGraph and Twitter card cloning: all subpages inherit generic homepage social preview cards and point og:url to the homepage
Thin content risk on 9 high-intent landing pages (<300 words on key conversion and feature URLs)
Missing AI discoverability standards: llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and .well-known/ai-catalog.json return 404
Missing essential HTTP security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
quick_wins: Add `alternates: { canonical: './' }` in `layout.tsx` to automatically emit canonical tags on all routes
Isolate `<JsonLd />` FAQPage schema so it only renders on `/` and `/faq` rather than sitewide in `RootLayout`
Fix title duplication in `guides/page.tsx`, `support/page.tsx`, and `terms/page.tsx` by removing redundant ` | Printora`
Add `/qr-code-web-printing` to `Footer.tsx` and navbar to resolve internal linking asymmetry
Fix H1 to H3 skip in `guides/page.tsx` by wrapping guide cards in an accessible `<h2>` section heading
Create `public/llms.txt` and `public/llms-full.txt` to enable rapid indexing by LLMs and answer engines

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% HTTP 200 responses across all 26 crawled URLs with 0 broken links
Valid robots.txt properly linking to XML sitemap
Clean XML sitemap with 26 accurate routes, priorities, and lastmod timestamps
100% static prerendering with Next.js Turbopack engine (<20ms TTFB)

findings.title: Complete Absence of Canonical URL Tags
findings.description: None of the 26 pages on the site output a `<link rel="canonical">` tag. Without canonical tags, search engines cannot resolve URL parameter variations, tracking tags, or protocol duplicates, diluting link equity.
findings.recommendation: Configure `alternates: { canonical: './' }` in `src/app/layout.tsx` and ensure page-specific canonicals are preserved.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security and Hardening Headers
findings.description: The response headers expose `X-Powered-By: Next.js` and lack `X-Frame-Options`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, and `Permissions-Policy`.
findings.recommendation: Add a `headers()` block in `next.config.ts` specifying strict security headers and set `poweredByHeader: false`.

findings.title: Internal Link Asymmetry for /qr-code-web-printing
findings.description: While 25 routes have 26 inbound internal links each from global navigation, `/qr-code-web-printing` only has 1 inbound link on the entire site because it is omitted from Footer.tsx.
findings.recommendation: Add `/qr-code-web-printing` to the Solutions column in `src/components/Footer.tsx`.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: In-depth 3,259-word homepage with comprehensive technical architecture and hardware specifications
Clear, user-focused instructions covering both Android native and iOS QR web workflows
Strong privacy and transparency focus explaining local-first data processing

findings.title: Thin Content on 9 High-Intent Feature & Landing Pages
findings.description: Nine routes contain fewer than 300 words of body copy (/mobile-document-scanner-to-pdf: 236w, /download/android: 261w, /features/ocr: 264w, /qr-code-web-printing: 267w, /remote-printing-from-phone: 267w, /print-from-ipad-to-windows-printer: 271w, /features/document-scanner: 272w, /id-card-scanner-to-pdf: 273w, /download/windows: 293w). These pages target high-volume search queries and risk being deemed doorway or low-value pages.
findings.recommendation: Expand thin landing pages to 500-750 words by adding step-by-step troubleshooting, system requirements, FAQ accordions, and hardware tips.

findings.title: Lack of Visible Author & Editorial Timestamps (E-E-A-T)
findings.description: Guide and technical pages attribute authorship to generic 'Printora Team' with no individual author bio, technical reviewer profile, or visible 'Last Updated' date.
findings.recommendation: Add structured author/reviewer credits and a visible 'Last updated on [Date]' badge to all guides and technical documentation.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 100% of pages have unique, descriptive H1 tags
100% of pages have meta descriptions defined
Concise, keyword-relevant URL slugs across all routes

findings.title: Doubled Brand Suffix in Titles (/guides, /support, /terms)
findings.description: Next.js layout template specifies `%s | Printora`, but three pages explicitly included `| Printora` in their metadata export, rendering titles such as 'Printing & Scanning Guides Hub | Printora | Printora'.

findings.title: Sitewide Social Preview Duplication (OpenGraph & Twitter)
findings.description: All 26 pages inherit the root homepage openGraph and twitter card definitions. Every page displays the homepage title, description, and points `og:url` to `https://printora.app`.
findings.recommendation: Configure dynamic or page-level OpenGraph/Twitter definitions so each route displays its specific title, description, and canonical URL when shared.

findings.title: Heading Level Skip on /guides (H1 to H3)
findings.description: In `src/app/guides/page.tsx`, the document jumps from `<h1>` directly to `<h3>` on the guide cards, skipping `<h2>`.
findings.recommendation:
Wrap the guides grid with a section `

All Guides & Step-by-Step Walkthroughs

` or change card titles to `

`.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD markup without parsing errors
Detailed SoftwareApplication schema for Windows and Android platforms
Organization schema with official GitHub repository linkage

findings.title: Sitewide FAQPage Schema Pollution from RootLayout
findings.description: Because `<JsonLd />` is placed in `RootLayout`, all 26 pages (including /terms, /privacy, /download/*, and /features/*) inject 10 FAQ items into their structured data. Google Search Central explicitly forbids injecting FAQ markup on pages that do not visually display those exact FAQs.
findings.recommendation: Remove FAQPage schema from `RootLayout` and inject it selectively on `/` and `/faq` only.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList Schema on Nested Routes
findings.description: None of the subpages (features, downloads, guides, solutions) output `BreadcrumbList` schema, forfeiting hierarchical breadcrumb trails in search snippets.
findings.recommendation: Implement `BreadcrumbList` structured data for all subpages.

findings.title: Missing HowTo Structured Data on Technical Guides
findings.description: Step-by-step guides like `/print-from-android-to-windows-printer` and `/print-from-iphone-to-windows-printer` lack `HowTo` schema with structured steps and prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Add `HowTo` schema to all 8 procedural guides.

findings.title: Large Inline HTML Payload on Homepage (366KB)
findings.description: The homepage raw HTML transfer size is 366KB due to comprehensive embedded content, SVG icons, and inline JSON-LD schemas.
findings.recommendation: Ensure gzip/brotli compression is active in production edge reverse proxies (Cloudflare).

findings.title: Missing llms.txt and llms-full.txt Discovery Endpoints
findings.description: The standard /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt files returned 404. These files are required by LLM aggregators and AI answer engines to accurately summarize product capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Create `/public/llms.txt` and `/public/llms-full.txt` providing a concise markdown overview of Printora's architecture, compatibility, and core guides.

findings.title: Missing .well-known/ai-catalog.json
findings.description: /.well-known/ai-catalog.json returns 404, omitting machine-readable service discovery for autonomous agents.
findings.recommendation: Provide an AI agent catalog describing the web print studio and local bridge capabilities.

categories.name: Images

findings.title: PNG Format Used for Brand Assets Without WebP Fallback
findings.description: The site uses logo.png (2KB) directly instead of modern WebP or SVG format.
findings.recommendation: Convert logo.png to SVG or WebP format for optimal compression.
